wikipedia.description: 1975–1977 state of emergency in India under Prime Minister Indira Gandhi
wikipedia.extract: The Emergency in India was a 21 month period from 1975 to 1977 when prime minister Indira Gandhi declared a state of emergency across India by citing internal and external threats to the country.
